name: ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION L
summary: ESDS Software Solution Limited operates as a provider of cloud and data center services, offering integrated solutions across cloud infrastructure, managed services, and software platforms. The company provides cloud infrastructure solutions, including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Software as a Service (SaaS), and managed services. It offers government community cloud (GCC) and enterprise community cloud (ECC) platforms, managed security services, advanced IT assistance, and pay-per-use models.
